module ProgressHelper
  def calc_progress(user_points, total_points)
    return 0 if user_points.blank? || total_points.blank?

    if total_points.zero?
      0
    else
      [user_points.fdiv(total_points) * 100, 100].min.floor
    end
  end

  include Rails.application.routes.url_helpers

    new(visual_url: visual, statement:, course_path:).tap do |presenter|
      presenter.parse_statement! unless statement.nil?
    end
  end

  def parse_statement!
    @quote_by = @statement[/(.*)###(.*)/m, 2]
    unless @quote_by.nil?
      @quote_by.strip!
      @statement = @statement.split('###')[0]
    end
    @statement&.strip!
  end

  def render_statement
    render_markdown @statement
  end

  def statement?
    @statement.present?
  end
end

# Build a hash from token and userID., can handle a user id or a user object
  def ical_hash(user)
    user_id = user.is_a?(String) ? user : user.id
    token = Xikolo::Account::Token.create(user_id:)
    Acfs.run
    dig = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest [user_id, token.token].join
    dig[10..20]
  end

def ical_url(user, full_path: false)
    path = "ical.ical?u=#{UUID(user.id).to_param}&h=#{ical_hash(user)}"
    if full_path

    else
